0XNJobSdgm7bl0H_D43o-Q.zh: WHO更新懸掛荷蘭國旗的郵輪群聚事件,截至5/4累計報告2例確診及5例疑病例,其中3例死亡及1例重症。船上共147名人員(含括23個國籍),4/1從阿根廷出發,發病日介於4/6-28,目前郵輪停靠維德角近海,相關單位已展開後送、撤離及監測等措施。WHO表示過往於歐、亞的致死率(CFR)為 1-15%,而於美洲的致死率可達50%,並評估本事件對大眾風險為低。
0XNJobSdgm7bl0H_D43o-Q.en: WHO has updated information on the cruise ship flying the Dutch flag. As of 4 May, two confirmed cases and five suspected cases had been reported cumulatively, including three deaths and one severe case. There are 147 people on board (of 23 nationalities). The ship departed Argentina on 1 April, and onset dates ranged from 6 to 28 April. The ship is currently anchored off Cape Verde, and relevant authorities have initiated transfers, evacuations and monitoring. WHO states that the CFR historically reported in Europe and Asia is 1–15%, while in the Americas it can reach 50%, and assesses the risk to the public from this event as low.

FPYXcGPlzcK788Dymf39uQ.zh: ECDC更新維德角相關疫情,自2022年9月截至今年3月,累計報告776例具維德角旅遊史的桿菌性痢疾確定及疑病例,病患分布於13個歐盟國家、英國及美國,經調查病患皆曾居住維德角某連鎖旅館,惟感染源尚未釐清,當局呼籲至維德角旅遊的遊客應落實食物飲水衛生措施。此外,同時期累積報告逾300例病例,感染其它病原體如沙門氏菌等。
FPYXcGPlzcK788Dymf39uQ.en: The ECDC has updated information on the outbreak linked to Cape Verde. From September 2022 through March this year, 776 confirmed and suspected bacillary dysentery cases with travel history to Cape Verde have been reported cumulatively, distributed across 13 EU countries, the United Kingdom and the United States. Investigations found that all patients had stayed at a chain hotel in Cape Verde, but the source of infection has not yet been identified. Authorities urge travellers to Cape Verde to strictly observe food and water hygiene measures. In the same period, more than 300 cases of infection with other pathogens, such as Salmonella, were also reported cumulatively.

ol-lkLPd6NRSS7tk1OsWIA.zh: 英國疫情更新,自2025年10月起迄今年2/8累計報告158例病例,其中112例有維德角共和國旅遊史,並已報告至少4例死亡案例,當局已發布旅遊建議,呼籲遊客勤洗手、避免生食。另荷蘭、瑞典、法國及愛爾蘭亦有報告與維德角共和國相關之病例。
ol-lkLPd6NRSS7tk1OsWIA.en: The UK's outbreak update: from October 2025 to 8 February this year, 158 cases have been reported cumulatively, of which 112 had travel history to the Republic of Cabo Verde (Cape Verde), and at least 4 deaths have been reported. Authorities have issued travel advice calling on travellers to wash their hands frequently and avoid eating raw food. Cases linked to Cape Verde have also been reported in the Netherlands, Sweden, France and Ireland.

BS721gbmMSL-bbh58rZwqg.zh: 英國自10月截至12/9累計報告137例病例,病患年齡以50-59歲為主(占40.1%),並以女性為多,有9成病患有維德角共和國旅遊史,經全基因定序檢測顯示為同一感染來源。
BS721gbmMSL-bbh58rZwqg.en: The United Kingdom reported 137 cases cumulatively from October to 9 December. Patients are mainly aged 50–59 (40.1%) and are mostly female. 90% of patients had travel history to Cabo Verde, and whole-genome sequencing shows that they share the same source of infection.

E7JoYRQA3pnBbHwA0NvpNA.zh: 維德角疫情更新,最近1個月報告逾8,000例病例,2024年迄今累計44,410例病例(17,942例確診),8例死亡,病例分布於該國9島嶼,以聖地亞哥島之病例數最多,該國主要流行型別為DENV-1及DENV-3。
E7JoYRQA3pnBbHwA0NvpNA.en: Cape Verde epidemic update: In the past month, over 8,000 cases were reported. In 2024 to date, 44,410 cases (17,942 confirmed) and 8 deaths have been recorded cumulatively. Cases are distributed across the country's nine islands, with the most on Santiago Island. The main circulating serotypes in the country are DENV-1 and DENV-3.

BOaH8qGcIOaGKWXkcdklIw.zh: 非洲疫情更新,2024年迄今累計176,481例病例(30,324例確診),136例死亡,以布吉納法索及維德角病例數為多。
BOaH8qGcIOaGKWXkcdklIw.en: Africa epidemic update: From 2024 to date, 176,481 cases (30,324 confirmed) and 136 deaths have been reported cumulatively, with the largest numbers in Burkina Faso and Cape Verde.
